items.title: We don't use AI in any of our design or production processes
items.raw_excerpt: The letters we write with are not abstract shapes. They are the result of a millennia-long process of evolution. A baton, passed down through a hundred generations, and carrying with it the influence of every one of them.

title_i18n.en: We don't use AI in any of our design or production processes
title_i18n.zh: 我们在任何设计或生产流程中都不使用人工智能。
title_i18n.es: No utilizamos IA en ninguno de nuestros procesos de diseño o producción.

excerpt_i18n.en: The letters we write with are not abstract shapes. They are the result of a millennia-long process of evolution. A baton, passed down through a hundred generations, and carrying with it the influence of every one of them.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们书写的字母并非抽象形状，而是历经数千年演化的产物。这根接力棒传过上百代人，承载着每一代的影响。
excerpt_i18n.es: Las letras con las que escribimos no son formas abstractas. Son el resultado de un proceso de evolución milenario. Un testigo, transmitido a lo largo de cien generaciones, y que lleva consigo la influencia de cada una de ellas.
